QuestInfo.name: [Labyrinth of Suffering] Traces in the Endless Labyrinth
QuestInfo.0: When the plan didn't work out, Azalin became lost in thought. She may be contemplating searching for supplies herself.
QuestInfo.1:
Azalin shouldn't be by herself in this place... Nobody should, really... So you're helping her continue searching for a way out.

(* You can move through the #bdoor on the left#k in #r#m450011220##k.)
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, you defeated the enemy, but unfortunately, you lost your way in the process. When you finally did reach the end of the path, you found several fallen soldiers.
